name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 77 - Am 154
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 77a. Considers the increase of EUR 103,546,512 (+ 4,09 %) in Parliament’s budget compared with 2025 to be unjustified, as it is almost double the inflation rate in the euro area; considers that Parliament should set an example by making savings and refraining from increasing its own operating budget;
